profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ ServiceTitan | ex Blizzard
profile.summary: At Blizzard, I worked on the Warcraft Rumble server core engine team. I built backend features, fixed bugs, and implemented a global matchmaking system that replaced regional queues and reduced wait times. At HypGames (Niantic), I developed backend systems and ProtoBuf schemas, optimized data transfer and caching, and connected server functionality with frontend workflows. At Hoodwinked Studios, as one of two cofounders on Starlost (500,000+ players), I managed backend systems, cloud services, and live operations. I’ve also worked on enterprise systems at ServiceTitan, building production-grade SaaS workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the Warcraft Rumble team in a server core engine focus.
Responsible for backend features and bug fixing on a distributed microservice architecture.
Tasked, researched and developed a solution to turn matchmaking from isolated feature sites into global matchmaking to allow users across the world to play together.
Technologies - Cassandra, Kafka, Kubernetes, C# .net 8, grpc, protobuf
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · NoSQL · Algorithms · Distributed Systems · Multithreading · System Development · Bug Tracking

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and built Java server modules for game functionality
Implement client side features in C# for Unity
Worked closely across disciplines with artists, designers and engineers
